failures.note: MEASURED. Root cause of this and of tests/test_service_host.py: engine/runtime/python313._pth REPLACES sys.path[0], and the entries it lists are python313.zip, '.', Lib/site-packages, ../backend, ../mailhub and ../../ - that is engine/backend, engine/mailhub and the repo root, but NOT engine/ itself. Both launch.py and startup_progress.py live in engine/, so neither can be imported by a child run under that runtime. THE INVOCATION FORM IS IRRELEVANT: measured both ways against a sibling module in a temp dir, and [sys.executable, '-c', code] and [sys.executable, <script path>] both give sys.path[0] = '...runtime/python313.zip' and both raise ModuleNotFoundError - so the usual 'a script path puts its own directory on sys.path' does not save it (measured by delta-lock 2026-09-20 while reviewing this refresh; my own earlier note attributed the suppression to the -c form specifically, which was under-general). The same defect was fixed in tests/test_engine_http.py at 73f7ba2, now on main: pass ORGTREE_TEST_CHECKOUT into the child env, have the child prepend <checkout>/engine/backend, <checkout>/engine and <checkout> to sys.path, then assert launch.__file__ is inside the checkout so a silent import from the INSTALLED app fails loudly instead of passing. That fix is verified for test_engine_http.py and NOT YET APPLIED here.
